text:
I re-checked the schedule against all 17 constraints and every one holds.

- Ben can't be in slot 6: that forces Ann to 7, Elif to 5 or 9, and Cara to 4 or 8. Elif in 9 leaves Dev nowhere, and Elif in 5 puts Cara at 4, which breaks "Ann before Cara".
- Ben can't be in 7 or 8 (Cara would have to come after Ann in slot 9 or not at all), and slots 1–4 can't hold the four people who must precede him. So Ben is in slot 5.

The team note about swapping spaces and underscores doesn't apply to this scheduling puzzle, so I didn't use it.
